obs=robot.observe(camera=2)

import limited_client as robot, numpy as np
obs=robot.observe(camera=0)
r=obs['robot']; q=np.array(r['joint_positions'],float); g=np.clip(np.array(r['gripper_positions'],float),0,.04)
x=np.array(r['tcp_position'],float)
# Approximate local translational Jacobian from earlier small, observed perturbations.
J=np.array([[-.226,-.003,-.192,-.025,-.204,-.011],[-.020,.082,-.023,.133,-.026,.196],[-.020,-.245,-.024,.454,-.029,.044]])
target=np.array([-.13,.245,.98])
err=target-x
# Move only a fraction toward the target; regularize and cap each joint step.
dx=err*.22
dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+.02*np.eye(3),dx)
dq=np.clip(dq,-.12,.12)
qt=q.copy(); qt[:6]+=dq
print('BEFORE',x.tolist(),'ERR',err.tolist(),'DQ',dq.tolist())
print('STEP',robot.step(qt.tolist()+g.tolist()))
o2=robot.observe(camera=0)
print('AFTER',o2['robot'])
print('STATUS',robot.status())
